# Module map (generated reference)

Every package under `src/ait/` and the modules in it, with the first line of each module's docstring (`-` means the module has none). Where each package fits in the running system: [GUIDE.md](../GUIDE.md#component-map). Who owns what and how to extend it: [TECHNICAL_GUIDE.md](../TECHNICAL_GUIDE.md#1-layout-and-ownership).

| `main.py` | AIT v2 — Main entry point. |

## `backtesting/`

Backtesting engine for strategy validation before live trading.

| Module | What it is |
|---|---|
| `dte_report.py` | What a DTE-searching walk-forward actually found (pure functions). |
| `engine.py` | Backtesting engine for simulating trading strategies on historical data. |
| `ex_div.py` | The research twin of live's ex-dividend ENTRY block . |
| `expiry_calendar.py` | Which expiry does an option "N days out" actually have? |
| `friction.py` | Per-leg option half-spread model in DOLLARS (friction model v2). |
| `gate_parity.py` | Which research entry gates have a live twin, and which exist on one side only. |
| `iv_model.py` | The research engine's implied-vol PROXY constants, defined once. |
| `iv_rank_compare.py` | Pure comparisons between the research engine's IV-rank veto and live's IV-rank gates. |
| `iv_surface.py` | An implied-vol surface fitted from REAL option bars (research only). |
| `learner.py` | In-backtest self-learning adapter. |
| `pool.py` | Shared-capital allocator for walk-forward. |
| `pricing.py` | Black-Scholes pricing primitives for the backtest engine. |
| `range_bank.py` | Per-horizon range models for ONE (window, symbol). |
| `replay.py` | Research-vs-reality PARITY REPLAY (read-only). |
| `result.py` | Backtest result container with performance metrics. |
| `run_record.py` | The per-run record of a research run (what produced this number?). |
| `settlement.py` | What happens to an option structure that reaches its expiry bell. |
| `study_harness.py` | The research "study harness" engine setup, defined once. |
| `walkforward.py` | Walk-forward backtester with multi-symbol support. |
